title: The Store Owns Its Keys
prompt: Prove the ownership rule: kv_put must copy the caller's bytes. The store's observable behavior must not change when the caller's buffer is modified or reused after the put.

tests.name: caller may clobber
tests.hint: After put, the caller's buffer is theirs to reuse.

tests.name: distinct keys stay distinct
tests.hint: Distinct keys must never share storage.
